source_capture_scope.scope: Only owner-confirmed static source roots, sealed audit fixtures, copied Git context and exact selected repository files. Isolated fixture DB, lock, gate, source and log files are retained. All active runtime roots and their source, DB, budget, gate, lock and log files are excluded.
limits: Nested receipt objects are qualified by their original producer namespaces. Immediate publisher receipt scanning by the generic packager does not establish transitive nested receipt completeness.
Frozen r01 and original source roots referenced by the current coverage report remain external dependencies preserved by existing archives; this archive is additive.
Three unavailable original security objects stay unavailable and were neither restored nor read.
Later r15, r16 and index metadata are outside this captured scope. Any optional Pinterest activation independent root or r17 report not sealed before capture remains excluded for later retention.

checks_actually_run: Confirmed static ownership and no further planned writes for every captured source root before capture.

Verified every declared member digest and all supplied size metadata for the authoritative root or leaf seals, including the separately located Meta audit seal. Independently derived omitted historical sizes and retained declared generated cache exclusions.
Independently inventoried every owner-frozen regular file, then copied exact bytes and nanosecond modification times into a fresh source tree.
Captured point in time Git HEAD, branch, status, remotes and selected binary diff, exact selected compact continuation reports and five portable Meta source or test files.
The canonical packager read back every regular archive member and three embedded evidence payloads before publishing its new local archive filename.
A separate verifier independently read back every archive member, rejected duplicate or unexpected paths, checked byte sizes and hashes and rehashed the complete compressed archive.
Rehashed all original static source files, staged copies and selected repository files after packing; no byte, size or mtime changes occurred.
Rehashed every prior durable archive and sidecar captured in the stable destination baseline; all byte sizes, hashes and nanosecond modification times remained unchanged.
limits: This is authorized additive local packaging, without publication or network collection.

The Meta extraction working tree has three authoritative sealed leaves and owner-confirmed static material outside them. The archive independently binds that whole tree without inventing a preexisting whole tree seal.
The two-file duplicate DoorDash independent root has no standalone seal. Its exact files match the sealed triage copy, and this archive independently binds both namespaces.

Fixture databases, gates, locks, prepared source and logs belong to static isolated or stopped evidence. All active runtime roots and their active source, DB, budget, gate, lock and log files were excluded.

The generic publisher receipt scanner inspects only immediate publishers paths. A zero immediate gap count does not prove nested or transitive receipt completeness. Original receipt namespaces and external dependencies remain qualified.
Earlier durable archives are preserved. This archive adds completed static continuations and does not replace original evidence, missing original security objects or frozen r01 coverage.
Archive retention does not establish canonical HTML equivalence, rendered media completeness, publisher lifetime enumeration, deliberate reading or agent behavior scores.

Repository Git context is a point in time capture, not a claim that all concurrent repository work was frozen. The r14 report is written after archive verification and is intentionally outside its own archived source snapshot.
